message.content: Given no visible swelling and no respiratory infection, possibilities include cervical muscle tension or strain, early non-infectious pharyngitis from irritation, allergy, dry air, or reflux; perceived swelling may be muscle tightness, lymph node soreness, or anxiety. Also consider dehydration, poor posture, dental or oral irritation, or early viral illness before signs appear. I would examine neck, nodes, throat, ears, and review medications or allergens. Seek urgent care for breathing trouble, drooling, fever, rash, severe stiffness, or inability to move the neck.
